milestone_2: Achieve Commercial Production at Sangdong Mine
milestone_3: Establish Tungsten Supply Chain and Secure Offtake Agreements
kill_risk: Dilution Risk due to At-The-Market Offering
thesis_summary: Almonty Industries has a strong unfair advantage in the tungsten mining market due to its exclusive Sangdong offtake deal, but faces significant survival risks due to its high burn rate and dilution risk.
thesis_breaks_if: Failure to secure additional funding or achieve commercial production at Sangdong Mine within the next 2 years
ten_k_highlights: We are a mining company focused on the production and sale of tungsten concentrate and other minerals.
Our Sangdong Mine in South Korea is a significant asset in our portfolio and has the potential to become a major player in the global tungsten market.
We are committed to maintaining a strong balance sheet and will continue to explore opportunities to reduce our debt and improve our financial position.
